title: Product Classification and Game/Add-on Relationship Model
context: Users need clean separation between full games and DLCs, while retaining the ability to track DLC discounts and view them on the parent game detail page.
decision: Introduce ProductClass enum and GameRelation table to model authoritative bundle-child and game-addon relationships based on Display Catalog metadata.
alternatives: Keep all products flat in one list
Delete DLCs and addons entirely from database
consequences: Base games and bundles separated from DLCs/Addons in default deals view
Dedicated /eklentiler route for browsing addon discounts
Authoritative GameRelation model connects base games with their verified addons and bundles with their children
risks: Unmatched orphan DLCs must cleanly display truthful fallback state without speculative parent linking.
